name: Phial of Scrying
summary: In Darkshore, scouts use the Phial of Scrying to reach Onu from afar. The ancient of lore provides the enchanted vessel, which calls forth a bowl for scrying across corrupted woodlands.

sections.title: A Lens Across Darkshore
sections.body: The Phial of Scrying carries mystical waters that form a temporary bowl on the ground. Scouts investigating deep within Darkshore use it for long-distance divination. From perilous places such as the Master's Glaive, they can speak directly with Onu instead of returning to his grove.

sections.title: Uncovering the Cult
sections.body: Onu gives the phial to watch the Twilight's Hammer cultists. A scout opens a scrying link at the place where an ancient fallen master lies impaled by an enormous glaive. The vision confirms that dark cultists are gathering around the ancient remains, seeking slivers of forgotten power that linger even in death.

faq.q: What does the Phial of Scrying do?
faq.answer: Uncork the Phial of Scrying and a magical bowl forms on the ground. From the field, you can use it to contact and speak with Onu across vast distances.

faq.q: Who provides the Phial of Scrying?
aliases: where do i get the phial
faq.answer: The ancient treant Onu gives the phial to scouts in Darkshore when he sends them to reconnoiter the Master's Glaive to the south.

faq.q: What happens if the phial is lost or exhausted?
faq.answer: If you lose the phial or use it before finishing your mission, Onu can give you another while he meditates in Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is Onu scrying into the Master's Glaive?
faq.answer: Onu knows an old lord fell at the Master's Glaive, and asks you to search there for Twilight's Hammer cultists. Their purpose becomes clear as the investigation continues.

angles.text: As a night elf of Darkshore, you know tools of divination such as scrying waters help keep watch over holy woodlands encroached upon by alien cults.
As a druid, you recognize scrying bowls as a blend of natural water and communion magic. They let the forest's wardens exchange whispers across corrupted ground.
